title: M-210

data.positioning_title: Where M-210 Fits in Product Evaluation
positioning_paragraphs: M-210 is a chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment specially treated with inorganic and organic compounds for masterbatch and plastics evaluation.

Use M-210 as a candidate when hiding, tinting, dispersibility, powder handling and processing behavior are relevant. Final selection should account for polymer, carrier resin, additives, pigment loading, processing temperature, equipment, appearance and destination documents.

data.applications_title: Plastics and Masterbatch Directions to Evaluate

applications.title: Polyolefin Masterbatch
applications.text: Evaluate M-210 at the intended pigment loading and carrier resin. Confirm dispersion, hiding and tinting, color direction, powder handling, processing and dilution performance.

applications.title: Engineering Plastics: PE, PP and ABS
applications.text: Test M-210 in the actual PE, PP or ABS formulation, additives, temperature and equipment. Confirm dispersion, appearance, processing behavior and end-use suitability.

applications.title: PS and Its Copolymers
applications.text: Review M-210 in the intended PS or copolymer system. Confirm compatibility, color, hiding and tinting, dispersion and processing under actual conditions.

data.evaluation_title: What to Evaluate in Your Plastics Formulation

evaluation.title: Optical and Dispersion Review
items: Bluish-undertone direction in the complete formulation
Hiding power and tinting strength at intended loading
Dispersion in the selected polymer and carrier system

evaluation.title: Processing and Qualification Review
items: Dry-powder fluidity in handling and feeding conditions
Processing behavior at actual temperature and equipment settings
Compatibility with resin and additive package
Application conditions, destination needs and sample-validation results
